title: Tier
description: The rarity ladder — the single source of truth for quality-derived numbers. Each tier has a numeric id (its rank) and a name (the rarity level). Graded content references a tier by id rather than restating the numbers: a gem's engraving bonus (effectMagnitude) and relative value come from its tier.

id.description: The tier's rank (numeric entry id). Graded content references this number.

key.description: Symbolic key for the tier (e.g. 'common'). Optional for backward compatibility with tier data.

name.description: The rarity level (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary).

effectMagnitude.description: Fractional bonus to enchanted-effect magnitude conferred at this tier (e.g. a gem's engraving bonus). 0.20 = +20%.

valueFactor.description: Relative value/cost multiplier of content at this tier.
